LESSON: HADITH ON PURITY OF ACTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITHI
Topic 2.1: Hadith on Purity of Actions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Purity of Actions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is appearance and wealth not important in the eyes of Allah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance
2. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life
3. appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON PURITY OF ACTIONS
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on Purity of Actions helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HADITH ON PURITY OF ACTIONS
Study Hadith on Purity of Actions like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance

What this means
In this part you learn to read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Hadith on Purity of Actions” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life

What this means
In this part you learn to apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on Purity of Actions in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on Purity of Actions is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Hadith on Purity of Actions” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on Purity of Actions in your own words. (skill: apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on Purity of Actions to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance.
3. Practise this skill: apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on Purity of Actions from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on Purity of Actions: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Hadith on Purity of Actions?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is appearance and wealth not important in the eyes of Allah?
2. What does Allah look for when rewarding His servants?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on Purity of Actions means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance.
5. Be able to: apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
